Differential Equations

Owning Palette: CE Math

VIs to solve Ordinary Differential Equations

 

Palette Object Description
[ce] ODE R-K Solver of dX(t)_dt=F(t) particular case.vi Uses Runge Kutta method to solve particular case of ordinary differential equation when solution depends only on a time variable:
  dX(t)/dt = F(t) ,  X(0) = X0
In addition, the VI allows specifying additional parameters and evaluating them in formula.
[ce] ODE Solver.vi Solves ordinary differential equations:
    dX(t)/dt = F(X,t) ,  X(0) = X0
In addition, the VI allows specifying additional parameters and evaluating them in formula.
To determine the solution you can use either Runge-Kutta or Euler method. The Runge Kutta method is more accurate, the Euler method is faster.
